scope: Formal SELECTED plan construction/persistence before next-session monitoring
findings: allocateAndBuildPlans constructs planDate=nextTradingDate(scanDate) and plan fields including buyLow,buyHigh,breakout,maxChase,stop plus channel-derived mode.
Successful after-market flow saves operational plans to STOCK_CONFIG_V7; intraday monitor later loads current operational state via loadStockConfig(env).
v8_trade_journal_plans is a durable plan-time ledger for system-recorded Formal plans and preserves plan_date,strategy,buy_low,buy_high,breakout,max_chase,stop and allocation/risk fields.
Therefore a system-recorded SELECTED row with a complete journal plan can positively establish PLAN_CONSTRUCTED at scan time.

However the immutable journal row and mutable operational KV do not currently expose a common immutable plan instance/hash/generation proving that every later monitor run consumed exactly that same plan instance.

safeStates.PLAN_CONSTRUCTED_COMPLETE: system-recorded Formal journal row exists and required plan fields are complete/valid for the selected symbol/date
safeStates.PLAN_CONSTRUCTION_INCOMPLETE: system-recorded Formal selected denominator is proven but its journal plan is absent or required fields invalid, subject to complete journal-day evidence
safeStates.RUNTIME_PLAN_MATCHED: requires positive immutable identity/version/hash linking monitor-consumed plan to constructed plan; not generally proven by current sources
safeStates.RUNTIME_PLAN_UNKNOWN: journal plan exists but exact monitor-consumed instance cannot be proven

provenanceGap: Trade journal is historical plan-time evidence.
Matching only symbol+scanDate/planDate/values is descriptive corroboration, not an immutable shared identity if either surface can be rewritten/recovered.
Recovered/manual rows must not be treated as equivalent to exact system-recorded Formal plans.
falsification: Do not infer monitor failure merely because runtime plan identity is UNKNOWN.
Do not infer plan construction failure from missing historical convenience readback unless the journal-day denominator is complete.
Do not use current KV to reconstruct historical plan state.
Do not use future outcomes in plan-validity classification.
optimizationBridge: This is evidence/provenance repair, not a BUY-rule optimization. It can isolate plan-construction scarcity from monitoring scarcity once denominator completeness is proven.
